masterclass-vs-coursera-vs-skillshare-vs.title: MasterClass vs Coursera vs Skillshare vs Udemy
masterclass-vs-coursera-vs-skillshare-vs.desc: Side-by-side comparison of MasterClass, Coursera, Skillshare and Udemy pricing, trials, refunds and certificates.
masterclass-vs-coursera-vs-skillshare-vs.answer: Choose Coursera for certificates, Udemy for one specific skill at a one-off price, Skillshare for hands-on creative projects, and MasterClass for inspiration from famous practitioners.
sections: Udemy, because you can buy a single course rather than subscribe. Coursera's monthly Plus has a 7-day free trial, and Skillshare offers a trial too.
Coursera, thanks to university and industry certificates and graded work.
Skillshare for short project classes; MasterClass for craft insight rather than step-by-step practice.

masterclass-vs-skillshare.title: MasterClass vs Skillshare
masterclass-vs-skillshare.desc: MasterClass vs Skillshare compared: price, billing, trials and who each suits.
masterclass-vs-skillshare.answer: Skillshare is the better hands-on learning tool for creatives; MasterClass is better for big-name inspiration. Both bill annually on the web.
sections: MasterClass lessons are cinematic talks from famous names; Skillshare classes are practical and project-led.

coursera-vs-udemy.title: Coursera vs Udemy
coursera-vs-udemy.desc: Coursera vs Udemy compared: certificates, subscription vs one-off course pricing, free trials, refunds and which to choose.
coursera-vs-udemy.answer: Coursera for recognised certificates and structured programs; Udemy for cheap, practical single courses with lifetime access.
sections: Udemy individual courses have a 30-day refund policy, but Udemy.com subscriptions do not. Coursera annual Plus has a 14-day money-back guarantee.

coursera-vs-edx.title: Coursera vs edX
coursera-vs-edx.desc: Coursera vs edX compared for university courses and certificates: free audit options, Coursera Plus pricing, trials and refunds.
coursera-vs-edx.answer: Both offer university content. edX's free audit track is good for sampling; Coursera Plus is better value if you'll take many courses.

codecademy-vs-datacamp.title: Codecademy vs DataCamp
codecademy-vs-datacamp.desc: Codecademy vs DataCamp compared for learning to code and data skills: prices, free tiers, trials, refunds and which suits you.
codecademy-vs-datacamp.answer: Codecademy for general programming and web development; DataCamp for data science, analytics and AI.

babbel-vs-duolingo.title: Babbel vs Duolingo
babbel-vs-duolingo.desc: Duolingo for a free daily habit; Babbel for structured, conversation-focused lessons.
babbel-vs-duolingo.answer: Duolingo for a free daily habit; Babbel for structured, conversation-focused lessons.

pluralsight-vs-linkedin-learning.title: Pluralsight vs LinkedIn Learning
pluralsight-vs-linkedin-learning.desc: Pluralsight for deep technical skills and labs; LinkedIn Learning for broad business skills bundled with Premium.
pluralsight-vs-linkedin-learning.answer: Pluralsight for deep technical skills and labs; LinkedIn Learning for broad business skills bundled with Premium.

udacity-vs-coursera.title: Udacity vs Coursera
udacity-vs-coursera.desc: Coursera is far cheaper and offers university certificates; Udacity is a pricier, project-intensive sprint.
udacity-vs-coursera.answer: Coursera is far cheaper and offers university certificates; Udacity is a pricier, project-intensive sprint.

futurelearn-vs-coursera.title: FutureLearn vs Coursera
futurelearn-vs-coursera.desc: Coursera has the bigger catalog and certificate range; FutureLearn suits short courses in health, teaching and psychology.
futurelearn-vs-coursera.answer: Coursera has the bigger catalog and certificate range; FutureLearn suits short courses in health, teaching and psychology.

skillshare-vs-domestika.answer: Skillshare for unlimited short classes; Domestika for in-depth courses you can keep.
